summary: First iteration full-stack testing for INTERNEW Orçamentos app. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passing covering public quote create/track, JWT login (success + wrong password + missing token), /auth/me, admin list/filter/stats/get/reply, PUT /admin/company (auth vs unauth), and end-to-end reply→track verification. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): submitted quote form → success screen shows 6-char code (61F095) → track pending → admin login → dashboard shows stats & new card → filter chips work → open detail, save reply → public track shows reply message and price. All critical flows work. Only RN web console warnings observed (shadow* style deprecation, pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver missing) — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated shadow* style props on web. Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card used in dashboard/cards).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warning appears on multiple screens. Likely coming from a library or Pressable usage; investigate.

action_items: Optional: migrate theme.shadow (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) to boxShadow for react-native-web to silence deprecation warning.
Optional: find and update deprecated pointerEvents prop usage (should be style.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id in reads (projection {"_id": 0}) and pops _id in /company.
JWT uses env JWT_SECRET, bcrypt via passlib, seed idempotent on startup.
All routes prefixed with /api; frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — correct.
All interactive elements have testID (submit, filters, quote-card-{code}, reply inputs, login, track).
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — FastAPI recommends lifespan; not a functional issue.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_ prefixed quotes via public POST /api/quotes (2 quotes). Company settings were briefly updated then restored to original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs via `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts=''` (root pytest.ini enables xdist which breaks shared pytest.quote_id — override addopts to disable). Admin credentials: admin@internew.com.br / Internew@2026. Base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
